headline: Continued four pending wetland requests to October meetings and issued a negative 3 determination for test pits at 5 Billerica Street and 85 Perkins Street.
summary: The Conservation Commission continued several pending Requests for Determination of Applicability and an enforcement order to October meetings. It ratified two emergency certificates for culvert and tree branch repairs, approved a negative 3 determination for test pits at 5 Billerica Street and 85 Perkins Street, and approved its 2027 meeting schedule and the August 26, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Continued the Winnco request to clean out the culvert at 451 Black Brook Drive to the October 14 meeting, 5-0.
Continued Vicki O'Neil's request for a single-family home at 10 Old Ferry Road to the October 28 meeting, 5-0.
Continued the CSX Transportation request for weed control via herbicide on the Lowell Train Track Right-Of-Way to the October 14 meeting, 5-0.
Continued the Enforcement Order against Alish and Jigarkumar Bhagat at 4 Epirus Drive to the October 14 meeting, 5-0.
Ratified the Emergency Certificate to repair the culvert at 141 Woburn Street, 5-0.
Ratified the Emergency Certificate for removal of a tree branch overhanging the structure at 97 Townsend Avenue, 5-0.
Issued a negative 3 determination for test pits at 5 Billerica Street and 85 Perkins Street, 5-0.
Approved the 2027 Conservation Commission schedule with a tentative 6:30pm start time, 5-0.

plain_text:
CONSERVATION COMMISSION 
LOWELL, MASSACHUSETTS 
September 23, 2026 
Note: These minutes are not completed verbatim. For further detail, video recordings are available at 
the Pollard Library, second floor reference desk or online at www.LTC.org. 
This meeting was held both in person and virtually using Zoom. 
Members Present: Chairman Brad Buitenhuys,  Vice Chair Perry Downs, Commissioner Marie Burns (via 
Zoom), Commissioner Kristin Ross-Sitcawich, Commissioner Roberto Ciccarelli 
Members Absent:  
Others Present: Dylan Ricker, Senior Planner 
CALL TO ORDER 
B. Buitenhuys called the meeting to order at 7:00 PM with a quorum of members present. 
ORDER OF BUSINESS 
CONTINUED BUSINESS 
Request for Determination of Applicability  
Winnco 
50 Braintree Hill Office Park, Suite 304 
Braintree, MA 02184  
Project Location: 451 Black Brook Drive, 01851 
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by Winnco seeking approval to clean out the 
existing culvert at 451 Black Brook Drive. The work will take place within the 100-foot buffer zone of a 
protected wetland. 
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
In Favor: 
None 
 
In Opposition: 
None 
 
Discussion:
B. Buitenhuys said no one has shown up for an extended period and noted the work is not on the 
property and it should not have been filed.  B. Buitenhuys said this should be continued to ensure how 
we can get this off of the agenda. 
Motion: 
P. Downs motioned to continue to the October 14 meeting, K. Ross-Sitcawich seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously, (5-0). 
 
 
Request for Determination of Applicability  
Vicki O’Neil  
31 Anderson Way  
Tyngsborough, MA 01879  
Project Location: 10 Old Ferry Road, 01854  
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by Vicki O'Neil to construct a single-family 
home at 10 Old Ferry Road. The applicant is seeking to determine whether the proposed work 
is located within the 100-foot buffer zone of a wetland resource area.  
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
In Favor: 
None 
 
In Opposition: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
B. Buitenhuys said the Commission received a request for continuance. 
Motion: 
M. Burns motioned to continue to the October 28 meeting, K. Ross-Sitcawich seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously, (5-0). 
 
Request for Determination of Applicability 
CSX Transportation 
500 Water Street 
Jacksonville, FL 32202 
Project Location: Lowell Train Tack Right-Of-Way 
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by CSX Transportation, Inc, regarding their 
plans for weed control via herbicide. The applicant is seeking to determine where the proposed work is 
located within the 100-foot buffer zone of a wetland resource area. 
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
In Favor: 
None
In Opposition: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
None 
 
Motion: 
P. Downs motioned to continue to the October 14 meeting, R. Ciccarelli seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously, (5-0). 
 
 
Enforcement Order 
Alish and Jigarkumar Bhagat 
4 Epirus Drive 
Lowell, MA 01854 
Violation Location: 4 Epirus Drive, 01854 
An Enforcement Order has been issued against 4 Epirus Drive. The violator has cut trees within the 100-
feet of a Bordering Vegetated Buffer (BVW). 
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
None 
 
Motion: 
M. Burns motioned to continue to the October 14 meeting, K. Ross-Sitcawich seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously, (5-0). 
 
NEW BUSINESS: 
 
Emergency Certificate 
City of Lowell Department of Public Works 
1365 Middlesex Street 
Lowell, MA 01851 
Project Location: 141 Woburn Street, 01852 
An emergency certification was issued to repair the culvert at 141 Woburn Street. 
 
On Behalf: 
David Beati, Applicant’s Representative 
 
D. Beati said the culvert is collapsing. 
 
Discussion: 
B. Buitenhuys asked if work has been completed. D. Beati said work started 1 week ago, the pipe arrived 
this morning and work is ongoing. D. Beati said he expects work will take 1-2 weeks. D. Beati said it is an 
82-inch pipe being slipped inside existing pipe. D. Beati said a sinkhole developed on Woburn St which
has spread. D. Beati said the request is the immediate repair. B. Buitenhuys said the request is 
reasonable. 
 
Motion: 
P. Downs motioned to ratify the Emergency Certificate, M. Burns seconded the motion. The motion 
passed unanimously (5-0). 
 
Emergency Certificate 
Deb Forgione 
97 Townsend Avenue 
Lowell, MA 01854 
Project Location: 97 Townsend Avenue, 01854 
An emergency certificate was issued for the removal of a tree branch overhanging the structure on the 
property at 97 Townsend Avenue. 
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
B. Buitenhuys asked if staff visited the site. D. Ricker confirmed and said the branch was overhanging a 
significant portion of the home and deck. 
 
Motion: 
P. Downs motioned, K. Ross-Sitcawich seconded the motion to ratify the Emergency Certificate. The 
motion passed unanimously, (5-0). 
 
Request for Determination of Applicability 
City of Lowell 
451 First Street Blvd 
Lowell, MA 01850 
Project Location: 5 Billerica Street and 85 Perkins Street 
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by the Lowell Regional Wastewater Utility to 
dig test pits to determine underlying soil conditions within the 100 foot wetland buffer zone at 5 
Billerica Street and 85 Perkins Street. 
 
On Behalf: 
Katie Campbell, Applicant’s Representative 
 
K. Campbell explained the proposed work to dig test pits. K. Campbell said they will be dug and filled in 
same day. 
 
In Favor: 
None 
 
In Opposition: 
None 
 
Discussion:
B. Buitenhuys requested they ensure it is not raining on the day of work. K. Campbell agreed. 
 
Motion: 
P. Downs motioned to issue a negative 3 determination, R. Ciccarelli seconded the motion. The motion 
passed unanimously, (5-0). 
 
OTHER BUSINESS  
 
2027 Conservation Commission Schedule 
B. Buitenhuys requested the meetings be moved to 6:30 if possible. B. Buitenhuys requested if it was 
possible to move all agendas up including this year. 
 
P. Downs motioned to approve the schedule with a tentative start time of 6:30pm, K. Ross-Sitcawich 
seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously, (5-0). 
 
8/26/2026 meeting minutes  
K. Ross-Sitcawich motioned to approve the minutes, the motion was seconded by R. Ciccarelli. The 
motion passed unanimously. (5-0). 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
P. Downs motioned to adjourn, the motion was seconded by K. Ross-Sitcawich. The meeting adjourned 
at 7:10PM
